overview: 2026-04-15 共整理 20 条重要新闻，其中科技与 AI 相关内容 20 条。当前为未经过模型重写的本地兜底结果。

news.title: Like Anthropic, OpenAI Will Share Latest Technology Only With Trusted Companies
news.summary: The maker of ChatGPT announced the limited release of GPT-5.4-Cyber, a technology designed to find security holes in software.

news.title: How Older Adults Are Using VR to Counter Social Isolation
news.summary: New tools tailored for use in senior living communities allow for shared experiences and social bonding.

news.title: Spice Up Your Cooking Skills With Help From Your Phone
news.summary: Recipe apps and artificial intelligence can give you a boost, but free tools already on your device can also assist with meal planning and preparation.

news.title: The Deepfake Nudes Crisis in Schools Is Much Worse Than You Thought
news.summary: An analysis by WIRED and Indicator found nearly 90 schools and 600 students around the world impacted by AI-generated deepfake nude images—and the problem shows no signs of going away.

news.title: Google to punish sites that trap people in with back button tricks
news.summary: The tech giant said it will punish sites that block back button navigation from June.

news.title: AI Slop Is Making the Internet Fake-Happy
news.summary: A new study examines the impact of the rise of AI-generated websites on the internet—and found some surprising results.

news.title: Booking.com customers warned of 'reservation hijacking' after hack
news.summary: The travel platform said it had changed Pins to protect customers but would not say how many were affected.

news.title: Best Smart Smoke Detector (and Why You Still Need a Dumb One)
news.summary: Every smart smoke alarm I’ve tested has one potentially fatal flaw, trading fewer nuisance alarms for a risky sensor strategy.

news.title: Allbirds Is Pivoting to AI Compute. Sure, Why Not
news.summary: Once a $4 billion apparel juggernaut, Allbirds will rebrand as NewBird AI, a “GPU-as-a-Service” company. Hey, if you can't beat ’em, join ’em.

news.title: MAGA Is Starting to Look Beyond Trump
news.summary: A seemingly endless torrent of criticism directed toward Trump from former MAGA allies suggests the president is losing support from his base.

news.title: We Don’t Really Know How A.I. Works. That’s a Problem.
news.summary: For us to trust it on certain subjects, researchers in the growing field of interpretability might need to learn how to open the black box of its brain.

news.title: The US Government Will Ask Data Centers How Much Power They Use
news.summary: In a letter obtained by WIRED, the Energy Information Administration tells two senators that it plans to develop a mandatory assessment of data centers' energy use.

news.title: Why Amazon Is Buying Globalstar—and What It Means for Your iPhone
news.summary: Amazon is paying more than $11 billion for a small satellite company.

news.title: Microsoft Surface PCs Are Getting Big Price Hikes, and the Cheaper Models Are Going Away
news.summary: The price increases range from $200 to $300, and Microsoft doesn’t sell a sub-$1,000 Surface anymore. The rising cost of consumer tech is a common theme in 2026.

news.title: AI Could Democratize One of Tech's Most Valuable Resources
news.summary: AI is making it easier to design chips and optimize software for different silicon. Some startups envision a revolution in chipmaking.

news.title: Ad Companies Settle With F.T.C. Over Claims of Harm to Conservative Sites
news.summary: WPP, Dentsu and Publicis settled claims they colluded on policies to combat misinformation, denying ad revenue to publishers on the right.

news.title: Snap Is Laying Off 16% of Full-Time Staff as It Embraces A.I.
news.summary: The company, which owns the social media app Snapchat, said it was laying off about 1,000 employees as it increased its reliance on artificial intelligence.

news.title: NASA Wants to Put Nuclear Reactors on the Moon
news.summary: The White House has announced that NASA will work with the Departments of Defense and Energy to put nuclear reactors in orbit and on the surface of the moon.

news.title: That Meeting You Hate May Keep A.I. From Stealing Your Job
news.summary: As artificial intelligence makes many tasks easier, the human work of cajoling, arm-twisting and reassuring appears to be rising in importance.

news.title: Ford Says Doug Field, Who Led Company's E.V. Push, is Leaving
news.summary: Doug Field, a former Tesla and Apple executive, had returned to Ford Motor in 2021 to help develop new electric models and software.
